gloss: higher rank; superior status; better quality

definitions.gloss: higher rank; superior status; higher class
definitions.explanation: Having a higher status, rank, or quality than something else being compared. Often used in competitive contexts like sports or business.

examples.japanese: {格上|かくうえ}の{相手|あいて}に{勝|か}った。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{私|わたし}より{格上|かくうえ}の{存在|そんざい}だ。
examples.english: She is of a higher status than me.

examples.japanese: {格上|かくうえ}のホテルに{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I stayed at a higher-class hotel.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{格|かく} (status, rank) + {上|うえ} (above)
Literally: "above in rank"

USAGE:
{格上|かくうえ} is commonly used in:
・Sports - comparing team rankings
・Business - comparing company status
・Quality - comparing product grades
・Social status - comparing positions

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{格上|かくうえ}の{相手|あいて} - higher-ranked opponent
・{格上|かくうえ}に{挑|いど}む - to challenge someone of higher rank
・{格上|かくうえ}げ - upgrading (adding げ suffix)

ANTONYM:
・{格下|かくした} - lower rank, inferior status

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in sports commentary and business contexts.
